    Order flow

    The order book, the direction of trades, resting liquidity and the futures market's gauges; for reading how price is met at a level.

    • Order book and liquidity

      • Order flow

      The order book lists the resting buy and sell orders for an asset by price.

    • CVD (cumulative volume delta)

      • Order flow

      CVD is aggressive buy volume minus aggressive sell volume, added up over time.

    • Liquidity heatmap

      • Order flow

      A liquidity heatmap shows the resting orders of the order book over time.

    • Funding rate

      • Order flow

      The funding rate is a periodic payment between long and short positions on perpetual futures.

    • Open interest

      • Order flow

      Open interest is the total of futures contracts not yet closed.

    • Liquidations

      • Order flow

      A liquidation is the exchange closing a leveraged position by force when its margin runs out.
